question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 E 组：库拉索 vs 科特迪瓦（2026-06-25，90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group E: Curaçao vs Côte d'Ivoire (2026-06-25, three-way 90-minute result)
one_liner_cn: 科特迪瓦 Elo 高出 261 分且刚客场击败法国，明显占优；库拉索作为首次参赛的最弱方，爆冷空间有限但末轮轮换带来不确定性。
one_liner_en: Côte d'Ivoire hold a 261-point Elo edge and just beat France away — clearly stronger; debutants Curaçao have limited upset potential, though matchday-3 rotation adds uncertainty.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 261 分（科特迪瓦 1695 vs 库拉索 1434），Davidson 模型基线即给科特迪瓦 64.4% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 261-point Elo gap (Côte d'Ivoire 1695 vs Curaçao 1434) gives Côte d'Ivoire a 64.4% baseline win probability in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 科特迪瓦 6 月 4 日在南特 2-1 击败法国，队史首胜法国，状态与信心正盛。
key_reasons.en: Côte d'Ivoire beat France 2-1 in Nantes on June 4 — their first-ever win over France — signalling strong form and confidence.

key_reasons.cn: 库拉索热身赛 1-4 不敌苏格兰，面对中上强度对手防线失分明显；世界杯首秀经验欠缺。
key_reasons.en: Curaçao lost 1-4 to Scotland in their warm-up, leaking goals against mid-tier opposition, and lack World Cup experience as debutants.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net ratings fetched 2026-06-11 (p_stat 14.3/21.3/64.4), plus a bounded evidence adjustment of +2.5pp toward Côte d'Ivoire (cap ±8pp) justified by cited form/depth facts; June friendlies already partly priced into Elo, hence the small delta. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.
